Subject: Comp signoff request: Aaron Cho - Senior Inference Engineer

Hi team,

Quick request — Aaron Cho (referred via Acme) is at final loop for Senior Inference Engineer (IC4/IC5 tilt). Interview feedback is strong: technical, systems design, and shipping inference infra. We want to move to offer but will need a comp exception to land him. Proposed package (subject to comp committee):

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (Level: Senior / IC4+).
- Base: $220,000 - $250,000 (targeting $235,000).
- Bonus: 12% annual
- Equity: 0.25% RSU (4y vest)
- Sign-on: $25,000

Rationale for higher band: candidate is coming off a deep LLM-inference implementation (latency optimizations + quantization) and has multiple competing offers from infra-first startups. Hiring manager recommends above midpoint to avoid losing him.

Request: can the comp committee approve an exception up to $245k base if needed? Need explicit approvals from Markus (final sign-off), Lauren (hiring ops), and Tessa (recruiting/payroll readiness). Attaching short summary.

Timeline: hoping to get sign-off by Friday 11/06 so we can send a verbal offer and follow with paperwork.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — attaching the Q3 compensation matrix and a short proposed offer summary (PDF). A few notes from comp:

- Market data supports a midpoint in the $225–240k range for candidates with demonstrated inference production experience in our region.
- The 0.25% RSU is within our standard band for Senior IC but we recommend front-loading the equity conversation in the offer to differentiate.
- Sign-on of $25k is reasonable given counteroffers; we can structure $15k up-front + $10k after 6 months if we need to stay under payroll constraints.

I recommend approving up to $245k base as an exception only if candidate explicitly requests it; otherwise $235k is competitive and clean.

Attachments: comp_matrix_q3_2026.xlsx, proposed_offer_summary-aaron-cho.pdf

Laura

Subject: Verbal offer and next steps — Senior Inference Engineer

Hi Aaron — great meeting you again yesterday. Following internal approvals, we are prepared to extend a verbal offer for Senior Inference Engineer. High-level summary: 

- Base: $235,000 (approved); exception up to $245,000 is reserved if we see a written counter-offer.
- Bonus: 12% annual
- Equity: 0.25% RSU (4y vesting)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (structured as $15k up-front + $10k at 6 months unless you prefer lump-sum)
- Start: flexible within 30 days (we can discuss specific date)

We will send an official offer packet via DocuSign once you confirm you are comfortable with the above. Arielle and I are available for any questions.

Can you confirm whether you prefer the milestone sign-on structure or a lump-sum? Also, any constraints on start date?

Thanks — excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood.

Best,
Jonas

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the quick coordination and the clear summary. A few quick items: 

- Equity vesting schedule: can you confirm cliff/quarterly schedule (I prefer front-loaded cliffs if possible).
- I’m leaning toward the lump-sum sign-on for personal reasons; if payroll needs a delay I can be flexible.
- Target start: mid-December (around 12/15) — that works on my side.

If you can confirm the equity cadence and whether the $245k is still on the table in case of a competing written offer, I’ll tell Arielle and we can proceed to DocuSign.

Best,
Aaron
